negativeOrNullFindings: There are NO randomised controlled trials of histrelin in the screened set - the phase 3 evidence is single-arm. Evidence grading should reflect that, not borrow confidence from the GnRH agonist class as a whole.
PMID 34147047 is a claims-database comparison, which carries confounding-by-indication that a dossier must state.
cautions: Evidence strength for this compound is materially weaker than for goserelin or triptorelin despite the same drug class. Grade it on its own literature.
Implant site reactions and implant breakage are the distinctive harms of this delivery form and are covered in the surgical-series papers.
